name: 微信小程序接入
description: 微信小程序的身份面：把 wx.login 的一次性 code 换成 openid，把 openid 绑到已有账号，然后签发内核会话。它拥有 p_wechat_accounts（openid ↔ users.id，一个账号一条）与 p_wechat_login_tickets（绑定票据，10 分钟、一次性）；凭据校验走 identity.public.loginWithCredentials，已绑定账号的静默重登走 identity.public.getLoginPayload —— users 是 identity 的表，本插件从不写它。AppSecret 只能留在服务端：官方明确 api.weixin.qq.com 不允许被配置成小程序的服务器域名，所以 code2session 必须在这里发。缺 WECHAT_APPID / WECHAT_SECRET 时插件照常启动，两条登录路由回答 503 而不是让整个应用起不来。

services.name: wechat.public
services._note: One method, getBindingForUser: does this account hold a WeChat binding? The account-deletion path asks it so a p_wechat_accounts row cannot outlive the users row it points at. Login is deliberately NOT a port - no other plugin needs to log anyone in over WeChat.

provides._routes_note: The two public routes are the only anonymously reachable ones here, and both are anonymous by necessity: `/login` carries a wx.login code (there is no session yet) and `/bind` carries the one-time ticket plus the account password. Every handler still resolves the caller itself where one exists - `/me` and `/unbind` 401 through requireActor - and `tests/e2e/publicRoutes.json` records the two exemptions with their reasons so the authorization audit can disagree with them.
provides._migrations_note: Registered through the plugin runtime, like `plugins/ai-study` and unlike `plugins/homework`. These two tables have no Prisma model on purpose: nothing in this plugin goes through Prisma, so adding them to `api/schema/appMigrations.ts` would also mean editing the pinned id list in `tests/guardrails/schema-lives-in-migrations.test.ts` for no gain. The prefix rule (`p_wechat_`) is checked by the runner before the DDL executes.

data._tables_note: Two namespaced tables, so nothing is adopted and the G10 legacy-adoption ratchet does not move. `adopted` and `reads` are both empty because every fact this plugin needs from elsewhere - the account row, its decrypted name, its class and the class-feature snapshot - arrives through `identity.public`, so no statement in `wechat.repository.ts` names another plugin's table and the ownership check in `ctx.db` has nothing to permit outside these two.
data._reads_note: Empty on purpose - see `_tables_note`. Reading `users` here would make this plugin a second reader of identity's table and would put the login payload composition in two places.
